blind_protocol: This file was committed BEFORE any disputed market was graded. Disputes may not be added, dropped, or reweighted based on grades; a dispute whose rules text cannot be fetched is reported as documented-but-ungradeable, never removed. Every source URL was loaded and verified during assembly.
inclusion_rule: Entries with confidence 'verified' enter the gradeable set. Entry 16 is excluded pending re-verification because its only loadable source explicitly declined to confirm the details — decided now, before grading.
kalshi_coverage_note: 4 solid Kalshi disputes were found, not the 5 the charter hoped for, after dedicated searching. Kalshi's centralized rules-filed settlement model generates fewer publicly contested resolutions than Polymarket's oracle model; the shortfall is recorded here rather than padded with weak cases.
control_rule: Per dispute: 3 settled, undisputed markets, same venue and category, nearest close-times, market_id tiebreak (atlas/proof.py select_controls). Never hand-picked.

disputes.market: Will Zelenskyy wear a suit before July?
disputes.disputed: Whether a NATO-summit outfit met the undefined 'suit' criterion; initial YES reversed via UMA vote.
disputes.conclusion: Resolved NO; upheld despite ~$237M volume and media consensus calling it a suit.

disputes.market: Ukraine agrees to Trump mineral deal before April?
disputes.disputed: A ~25%-of-vote UMA whale voted YES though no deal was signed in the window.
disputes.conclusion: Resolved YES against facts; venue called it a governance attack, no refunds.

disputes.market: MicroStrategy sells any Bitcoin by May 31, 2026?
disputes.disputed: 8-K disclosed an in-window sale after the cutoff; did resolution require the sale or its public confirmation before the deadline?
disputes.conclusion: Resolved NO after two disputed proposals and a UMA vote; traders sued alleging post-hoc rule change.

disputes.market: US and Iran sign a permanent peace deal
disputes.disputed: Whether a 60-day ceasefire extension met the contract's 'permanent' requirement.
disputes.conclusion: Still contested in verified reporting (~$345M volume).

disputes.market: Will the US invade Venezuela in 2025?
disputes.disputed: Whether the Maduro capture raid met the 'intended to establish control' invasion criterion; venue issued a mid-flight clarification.
disputes.conclusion: Resolved NO; ~$10.5M paid to NO holders amid backlash.

disputes.market: Venezuela Presidential Election Winner (Gonzalez markets)
disputes.disputed: Official CNE result vs opposition tallies: which of the rules' two sources ('official information' vs 'consensus of credible reporting') governed.
disputes.conclusion: UMA resolved for Gonzalez, overriding the official result.

disputes.market: TikTok banned in the US before May 2025?
disputes.disputed: Whether a one-day self-shutdown under the divest-or-ban law was a 'ban'.
disputes.conclusion: Resolved YES; upheld over user petition (~$120M volume).

disputes.market: Was Barron involved in $DJT?
disputes.disputed: UMA resolved NO; the venue publicly stated UMA got it wrong.
disputes.conclusion: Effectively overturned: venue paid YES bettors and pledged oracle changes.

disputes.market: Ethereum ETF approved by May 31?
disputes.disputed: Whether 19b-4 approval alone was ETF 'approval' with S-1s not yet effective.
disputes.conclusion: Resolved YES; disputed through UMA, upheld.

disputes.market: Will the missing submarine be found by June 23?
disputes.disputed: Whether located debris counted as 'found' under clarified cabin-referencing criteria.
disputes.conclusion: UMA vote resolved YES; upheld amid tokenholder-conflict allegations.

disputes.market: US Bitcoin reserve in first 100 days
disputes.disputed: EO created a reserve funded only with seized BTC, which the criteria excluded; market stalled unresolved.
disputes.conclusion: Resolution delayed amid objection; final outcome unconfirmed in verified sources.

disputes.market: Will Volodymyr Zelenskyy be the 2022 TIME Person of the Year?
disputes.disputed: TIME named 'Zelensky and the spirit of Ukraine' — edge case on the 'exclusively named' clause.
disputes.conclusion: Resolved YES by UMA vote; upheld.

disputes.market: Trump declassifies UFO files in 2025?
disputes.disputed: YES finalized via UMA though critics identified no declassification order; late whale buying preceded resolution.
disputes.conclusion: Resolved YES; upheld despite backlash (~$16M).

disputes.market: When will the Government shutdown end? (Nov 12 leg)
disputes.disputed: Bill signed Nov 12 but rules keyed on the OPM announcement, which came Nov 13.
disputes.conclusion: Upheld: resolved to Nov 13 per the OPM-announcement rule.

disputes.market: Cardi B performs at Super Bowl LX halftime
disputes.disputed: Whether dancing and mouthing lyrics in another artist's set was a 'performance'.
disputes.conclusion: Resolved YES at $1 — the opposite economic outcome from Kalshi's handling of the same event.
disputes.note: Fortune summary carried one detail inconsistent with CBS; CBS treated as the stronger source.

disputes.market: What will Trump say this week? (Khamenei leg)
disputes.disputed: Alleged utterances resolved NO citing possible mispronunciation; $170K lawsuit filed.
disputes.conclusion: Resolved NO; litigation pending.
disputes.excluded: Only loadable source explicitly declined to confirm details; excluded from the gradeable set unless re-verified. Decided before grading.

disputes.market: Khamenei out as Supreme Leader before March 1, 2026
disputes.disputed: Venue invoked a death carveout and settled at last pre-death price rather than YES; plaintiffs argue 'leaves office for any reason' covered death.
disputes.conclusion: Settled at last price; fees refunded and ~$2.2M covered; $54M class action pending.

disputes.market: Cardi B performs at Super Bowl LX halftime (Who will perform at the Big Game?)
disputes.disputed: Same event as #15: venue deemed the cameo unresolvable ambiguity and settled at last traded price instead of $1/$0.
disputes.conclusion: Settled $0.26/$0.74 across $47.3M; a CFTC complaint filed.

disputes.market: NFL Win Totals (49ers over 10.5 wins and peers)
disputes.disputed: Winning YES positions initially graded to return stakes, not $1 settlement value.
disputes.conclusion: Overturned after viral coverage: full settlement value paid via credits.

disputes.market: 2025 Oscars viewership above prior years
disputes.disputed: Settled NO on preliminary fast-nationals hours before final figures that would have flipped it; rules counted initial published figures.
disputes.conclusion: Upheld: venue said 'legal and correct' while conceding it 'did not capture the spirit'.
